purpose: Retrospective single-station seasonal pilot; not an operational or India-wide benchmark.

scoring.target_missing_policy: Drop missing target hours from every method equally; never fill verification observations.
scoring.aggregation: Pool identical matched forecast hours across accepted origins; do not average per-origin RMSE.
scoring.inference: Descriptive scores and paired per-origin comparisons only; no statistical significance claim.

failure_policy: Log every planned origin. Data rejection is distinct from download or inference failure. Infrastructure/model errors make the run incomplete.
limits: One station and a limited season; no annual or geographic generalization.
The July 1 demonstration trajectory is excluded from both evaluation splits.
Dates, checkpoint, inputs and gap rules are fixed before new model scores are inspected.
Earlier observations may enter later contexts once they are in the past; no future targets are used as inputs.
Historical forecast publication and observation receipt times are unverified. The six-hour run age is an assumption.
The 2025 ECMWF archive is labelled as a hindcast, not a proven operational vintage.
Exclusion of these dates from TimesFM pretraining is unverified.
Input/data eligibility can bias the accepted sample; report all rejections and denominators.
METAR rounding, unverified station sensor height, and Open-Meteo elevation handling remain limitations.
Do not change this protocol in place after inspecting scores; a revised experiment needs a new version.
